detailed_descriptions.en: Once in a generation, the gods come together to postpone the apocalypse. But this time, the god of communication started a bunch of godly fights and then went awol. With the sky splitting and the gods in disarray, who's gonna join the Bizzyboys to help SAVE DA WORLD FROM A-POCKY-LIPS??? As the gods’ mail-carrier, suck up and launch speech bubbles to solve puzzles. Deliver messages to chat, flirt, or hurt their feelings. The god of TEAMWORK? The god of LOVE SONGS? Drain it, who’s in charge around here…? You may be ready for: A big colorful world to explore Third and first-person gameplay Weird people. Weirder gods But are you also ready for: Godly crushes? Pumpkin fights?? Puppets cooking??? AND YOU’RE NOT READY FOR: Grovekeeping! Godbossing!! THE END OF THE WORLD AS WE KNOW IT!!!!! LimboLane is a creative duo making silly games that squish and bounce, comprised of designer Day Lane and animator Yugo Limbo. They have a love for the kitschy, the surreal, and the utterly bizarre. Their nod-and-shake adventure game Smile For Me was self-published on Steam in 2019 and re-released for consoles in 2023.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Once in a generation, the gods come together to postpone the apocalypse. But this time, the god of communication started a bunch of godly fights and then went awol. With the sky splitting and the gods in disarray, who's gonna join the Bizzyboys to help SAVE DA WORLD FROM A-POCKY-LIPS???

As the gods’ mail-carrier, suck up and launch speech bubbles to solve puzzles.

Deliver messages to chat, flirt, or hurt their feelings.

The god of TEAMWORK? The god of LOVE SONGS? Drain it, who’s in charge around here…?

You may be ready for:

  • A big colorful world to explore

  • Third and first-person gameplay

  • Weird people. Weirder gods

But are you also ready for:

  • Godly crushes?

  • Pumpkin fights??

  • Puppets cooking???

AND YOU’RE NOT READY FOR:

  • Grovekeeping!

  • Godbossing!!

  • THE END OF THE WORLD AS WE KNOW IT!!!!!

LimboLane is a creative duo making silly games that squish and bounce, comprised of designer Day Lane and animator Yugo Limbo. They have a love for the kitschy, the surreal, and the utterly bizarre. Their nod-and-shake adventure game Smile For Me was self-published on Steam in 2019 and re-released for consoles in 2023.
